column1: # Criterion11 compiler implementation matrix. The workflow column is the generated entry/factory or Runner path; execution_tier is independent.
# execution_tier names the target program being measured (the generated compiler program) for BOTH implementation rows.
# It never claims that rustc itself has a JIT or Source interpreter; the Rust-reference row runs the equivalent target program under the same tier contract.
# Diagnostic bytes/count and semantic equivalence are receipt correctness facts; only compile/resource/artifact/runtime costs are ratio-gated.

# Selfcompile rows require the private adapter to execute the canonical `valid-hello` and `invalid-missing-return` probes through the stage2 compiler; their frozen bytes are the valid-output and invalid-diagnostic fixtures in this contract, never sources.list itself.
# Web rows use the canonical web_hello fixture and its frozen Node/browser stdout; they require actual Web AOT bundle+Wasm/browser execution and do not imply Web JIT or compiler-in-browser support.
